item.title: Hindsight - Agent Memory Framework
item.description:
Hindsight - Agent Memory Framework

Open-source agent memory framework that retains experiences, recalls relevant information, and learns over time. Includes a server, client SDKs and APIs for building applications with persistent memory.
item.content:encoded:

Pay-as-you-go residential, datacenter and mobile proxies for web scraping, AI training data, ad verification, price monitoring and SEO monitoring. Offers country-level targeting, no subscription and 24/7 support.

item.title: GLM 5.3 Flash - Fireworks AI Model
item.description:
GLM 5.3 Flash - Fireworks AI Model

Fireworks AI listing for Z.ai’s GLM 5.3 Flash, a 320B-parameter mixture-of-experts model with a 1M-token context window. Supports serverless inference, function calling, image input and LoRA training; standard serverless pricing is listed.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: DeepSeek Harness - Plugin Collection
item.description:
DeepSeek Harness - Plugin Collection

A catalogue of standalone DeepSeek Harness plugins, including Metafolder, Model Picker, Adaptive Reasoning, Prompt Library and Steering, with installation guides and downloads. Also covers the Augmentor bundle and dated plugin collection.

item.title: Flowy - Self-Hosted Household Finance
item.description:
Flowy - Self-Hosted Household Finance

Open-source, self-hosted finance platform for shared household budgeting and financial organization. It is designed to replace disconnected banking apps, spreadsheets, and shared Google Sheets with a single collaborative workspace.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Pappice - Self-Hosted Support Desk
item.description:
Pappice - Self-Hosted Support Desk

Open-source, self-hosted support desk with a chat-style ticket workflow. It can run as a single binary or through Docker Compose, and supports customer conversations, internal notes, assignments, and ticket lifecycle tracking.

item.title: Conatus - Self-Hosted Task Manager
item.description:
Conatus - Self-Hosted Task Manager

Open-source, self-hosted task manager for projects, recurring work, reminders, collaboration, and automation. It includes Docker deployment and MCP/OpenAPI integration, and is positioned as a Todoist-inspired alternative.

item.title: BaryMusic - Live Lyrics and Setlist Manager
item.description:
BaryMusic - Live Lyrics and Setlist Manager

Web app for organizing songs and setlists, then displaying live lyrics on external screens through built-in channels. It is available as a Windows portable app or Docker deployment and includes an editor for lyrics and song structure.
